question: I'm an IS sophomore. I've taken 67-100, 67-250, 67-262, and 15-121. Which IS core professional courses am I still missing before I can graduate?
expected_answer: P-013 has completed some IS core courses but is still missing at minimum 67-272 (Application Design and Development) and 67-373 (Information Systems Consulting Project), which are required professional core courses for the IS degree. Additional requirements (concentration courses, general education, etc.) would also need to be checked.
reasoning_type: Requirement gap identification from course history
common_mistake: Listing only some missing core courses but omitting others; not distinguishing between the IS professional core and elective/concentration requirements
needs_verification: Confirm the complete list of IS professional core required courses
Confirm whether 67-100 (IS First Year Colloquium) is a graduation requirement or just recommended
Confirm all IS concentration/elective requirements relevant to P-013's undeclared status
Confirm P-013 has not declared a concentration that adds additional required courses
